findings.title: New harness source re-introduces the barred $HOME and host toolchain paths
findings.statement: SC-NIX-DEVENV-001 invariant 1 bars $HOME toolchains and invariant 10 bars any tool resolution that bypasses tools/lib/uos-toolchain.sh. These eight call sites bypass it. jj and gleam have pinned in-project equivalents (toolchains/nix-profile/bin/jj, toolchains/gleam-1.16.0/bin/gleam); chronyc and sqlite3 have no resolver entry at all.
findings.falsifier: bash -c 'source tools/lib/uos-toolchain.sh; uos_toolchain_verify' passes (locality arm bars $HOME/.cargo/* and $HOME/.nix-profile/*) while these call sites use exactly those prefixes; bash tools/preflight reports 33/33 green and covers none of them.
findings.current_risk: LOW today and that is the hazard: /home/an/.cargo/bin/jj reports 0.44.0 and /home/an/.nix-profile/bin/gleam reports 1.16.0, identical to the pinned versions, so nothing fails now and the coupling is silent.
findings.fix: Route through the resolver: add chronyc and sqlite3 to uos_tool_path and the preflight useable arm, and replace the jj/gleam/bash/env literals with resolved paths. Mirrors the repair already applied to tools/release_process.ml, unification_cycles.ml, evolution_cycles.ml and output_guard_check.ml.
findings.residual: Until then the harness clock, Sa-plan reader, build and test paths run on unpinned tooling that no gate observes.

findings.title: Development grant is authenticated by caller-controlled environment variables
findings.statement: binding() reads UOS_HARNESS_{ROLE,PLAN,TASK,WORKER,ATTEMPT,SESSION,EPOCH} via getenv and accepts only one hardcoded literal tuple, including session 01a083d2-baa3-7783-8e45-5357cc9e96d8 and attempt == 1. The module header states request payload fields never grant identity; environment variables are exactly as caller-controlled as payloads, so the fence is a naming convention, not a credential.
findings.falsifier: Any process able to set those seven variables presents the root coordinator identity to the harness. SYNC-06 already records that local filesystem access is the trust boundary, so this is consistent with the contract but stronger than the source comment implies.
findings.current_risk: Bounded: the allow-list is a single tuple and the bootstrap is finite.
findings.fix: State in the source that the grant is environment-asserted and bounded by the local filesystem trust boundary, or bind it to an artifact the caller cannot forge (a lease digest read from the canonical ledger).
findings.residual: attempt == 1 makes the harness single-attempt by construction: a crash needs manual re-grant. Deliberate and fail-closed, but it must not be generalised without redesign.

findings.title: Replay/idempotence claim (D11) is not exercised by anything this reviewer could observe
findings.statement: evaluate_task_window checks role, worker, attempt, deadline and dependency blocking, which is the right shape, but with attempt pinned to 1 by the grant the retry path that D11 is about cannot be reached in this configuration.
findings.falsifier: Set UOS_HARNESS_ATTEMPT=2 and the binding fails before the replay logic runs.
findings.current_risk: No false success observed; the claim is simply unverified here.
findings.fix: Exercise the replay path in a test that varies attempt while holding the grant, or restate D11 as designed-not-yet-verified.
findings.residual: D11 remains UNKNOWN rather than accepted.

findings.title: files.gleam bounded-edit primitives verified by reading, with disclosed limits
findings.statement: read() lstats, requires a regular file with nlinks==1 and size<=262144, opens raw/binary, then re-checks inode and dev against the open descriptor before pread, so a substituted final target is detected. create() uses O_EXCL plus fsync of the file and of the parent. replace() re-reads and re-checks the digest before an atomic rename and deletes the pending file on failure. ancestors() lstats every parent component and rejects any non-directory, so a symlinked parent is refused.
findings.falsifier: The module header itself states the residual: a parent rename race still needs a cooperative workspace lease, and this is not a descriptor-relative VFS.
findings.fix: None required for the stated scope. Two smaller points: the pending-file cleanup discards its own error (line 257), so an orphaned .harness-<nonce> file is possible and unreported; and replace() operates on UTF-8 strings only, so non-UTF-8 files cannot be edited at all.
findings.residual: TOCTOU between the second read and the rename remains, as disclosed.

findings.title: One clock policy field carries two semantics, and is 30x more permissive than the module's own strict baseline
findings.statement: policy is built positionally with five unlabelled integers. max_evidence_age_us=3_600_000_000 bounds the chrony reference age at line 78, while line 86 overrides the same field to 3_000_000 for contract.validate, where it bounds the boot-domain receipt age instead. The receipt labels at lines 134-135 do match the bounds actually applied, so this is not a false receipt; it is a legibility and maintenance hazard. Separately, clock_contract.strict_policy uses 120_000_000 for the same field, so the harness is 30x more permissive with no rationale in the source.
findings.falsifier: Reorder the Policy fields in clock_contract and the harness silently repurposes all five bounds; the positional construction gives no protection.
findings.fix: Construct the policy with labelled fields, split the two semantics into distinct fields (reference age vs receipt age), and record why 3600s is admitted where the strict baseline is 120s.
findings.residual: A future reader may reasonably conclude the published 1-hour bound governed the validate call, which it does not.

findings.title: No paid OpenRouter call receipt exists; absence is consistent with D20 but is not evidence of enforcement
findings.statement: var/harness contains the bootstrap risk receipt and effect intent/result artifacts; no paid-call receipt is present. The USD10/day ledger, USD0.25 per-request liability and reservation-before-call rule are declared in the risk receipt assumptions and budget fields.
findings.falsifier: A paid call made without a durable reservation would leave no artifact here either, so this reviewer cannot distinguish enforced from unexercised.
findings.fix: Emit a reservation receipt on every attempted paid call, including refused ones, so absence of spend becomes positive evidence.
findings.residual: D20 is accepted only as a design statement, not as an observed control.
